knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Guests touch these points often, so they are disinfected as well as cleaned to look right.
Spraying onto electrical items risks product entering the switch, and the label's contact time may not be met.
Dusting runs from the highest points down, so that anything knocked down is caught by the next pass.

practicalCriteria: Dusts a simulated room from the highest point to the lowest, including lampshades, frames, sills and furniture tops.
Wipes each listed high-touch surface with the approved product and leaves the label's contact time before drying, as observed.
Uses zone-coded cloths and changes a cloth after it is used on a dirty area.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 percent pass mark (all three correct). Practical criteria are observed and signed off separately by an assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: High-touch checklist completed for the simulated room
stopWorkCriteria: Product sprayed directly onto electrical items
Lampshade or fitting cleaned while still energised or hot
Work at height reached by improvised means
